The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 101a2a51cda87af8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For H, P, M, and σ as above, let (ρσ, Nσ) be any Weil–Deligne pair in c M with Weil part the semisimple local parameter of σ. Then CH(z, σ) . = Y b L 1 − b(z), r∨ b ◦ (ρσ, Nσ)  L b(z), rb ◦ (ρσ, Nσ)  . (4.3) In particular, one may take Nσ = 0.
